claims.claim: Vale's Q2 2026 iron ore production reached 84.3 Mt, its highest second-quarter output since 2018, while copper production reached 98.4 kt, the best second quarter since 2017.
Copper and nickel operating improvement creates a broader critical-minerals signal beyond Vale's iron-ore base.

risks.risk: Production growth alone does not establish margin improvement because realized commodity prices and unit costs remain separate variables.

unknowns.unknown: Current unit-cost trajectory and realized pricing conversion remain unknown in Scout evidence.

claims.claim: Q2 iron ore sales were 79.7 Mt, up 3% year over year; copper production rose 6% and nickel production 4% year over year.
S11D, Capanema/VGR1, Salobo, Sossego and Onca Puma/Long Harbour contributed to operating improvement, while Oman pellet plants experienced a temporary suspension.

risks.risk: Commodity cyclicality, operational interruptions and environmental/social liabilities remain material execution risks.

contradictions.contradiction: Broad production improvement does not itself prove margin or free-cash-flow improvement.

unknowns.unknown: Current quantified environmental/tailings risk and margin conversion remain outside this Scout artifact.
